summary: Commands whose middle path param comes from a flag (`--entity-type`, `--object-type`) read the next path id from args[1], not args[2].
reason: `workspaces attachments get-parent-entity`, `post-entity` and `acls public-patch` declare two positionals but required three and read args[2], so every correct invocation failed with `<id> is required`.
validated_outcome: Live `workspaces attachments get-parent-entity <workspace_id> <task_id>` returns the task's attachments; `acls public-patch --dry-run` builds /v3/workspaces/<ws>/<object_type>/<id>/acls.
